items.headline: $INJ Breaks Out on ETF Staking & Phantom Buzz
items.summary: $INJ rallied as ETF staking plans and a new Phantom wallet integration fueled fresh market hype around the Injective ecosystem.

items.headline: $POL to Burn 100M Tokens as Revenue Hits $24.5M
items.summary: Polygon plans a permissionless burn of 100M $POL after revenue reached $24.5M, though traders are split on whether it will lift the price.

items.headline: $HYPE Rallies as Crypto Shrugs Off Clarity Setback
items.summary: $HYPE joined a broad altcoin rally as markets looked past the stalled Clarity Act, with the SEC and CFTC still advancing crypto rulemaking.

items.headline: $AVAX: NYSE Tested Avalanche Tech for a Year
items.summary: Ava Labs' president revealed the NYSE spent a year testing $AVAX technology for tokenization plans, signaling deepening Wall Street interest.

items.headline: $EGLD Probes Potential Mainnet Issue
items.summary: MultiversX is investigating a possible issue affecting its mainnet, putting $EGLD holders on alert for further updates.
